_comment: The figures of the approved design, as data. This file is what the golden
test renders, so the frozen artefact is the page that was signed off rather
than a fresh invention of it.
Counts and labels only. No colours, no pixel heights, no percentages, no
markup: everything presentational is derived in pipeline/report/
dashboard_render.py, which is what stops next quarter's numbers from
changing how the page looks. Write text with literal characters (& — · ≥ ×);
Known gap, carried over from the design and reported by validate(): the
seven teams account for 3'541 of 3'934 activities. The residual is real and
unnamed, and every run says so until the source data or the row set changes.
title: Campaign activity overview
subtitle: Where leadership intervention may be needed — and with which teams or audiences.

insights.timing: The four weeks from 10 Aug to 31 Aug carry four of the five heaviest loads. Consider shifting non-critical sends out of the week of 17 Aug.
insights.priority: 60% of activities are rated High or share-price sensitive — a prioritisation review would free capacity.
insights.ownership: Group Communications plans nearly 1.5× the next team — check whether that reflects mandate or backlog.
insights.leadership: Four of seven teams sit at or below the portfolio average; Group Functions and Central Teams have the widest gap to the 20% target.
insights.reach: Executive time is spread thin: only 1 in 6 activities has board participation, while a third of the portfolio faces external audiences.

footer_notes: Audience figures are planning estimates, not measured reach. Scope is based on period overlap, not start date. Targets set by the Communications Leadership Team.
footer_source: Source: CPLAN report pack (calendar, activities, breakdowns)
